Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

childhood — the time when you were a child. Example: In my childhood I lived in a small town.
school — a place where children learn. Example: I went to a small school.
memory — something you remember. Example: My best memory is my first teacher.
live — to have your home somewhere. Example: I lived in a small town.
like — to enjoy something. Example: I liked playing football.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• In my childhood I ...
• I lived in ...
• I liked ...
• My best memory is ...
• I went to a small school.
